svg.aria-label: AgentRQ machines: you click Add machine and get a single-use code, and typing it on your own computer enrols it, so dev-box comes online. You pick the agentrq-web workspace and Start agent, and claude starts in that workspace's folder on the machine, straight into its terminal. Back on the machine page one session is running, and Machine Info shows CPU, memory and load climb while claude works and fall when it is done, and claude celebrates.
svg.title: AgentRQ machines: you click Add machine and get a single-use code, and typing it on your own computer enrols it, so dev-box comes online. svg.text: Enrol it once. Agents run in your repos.

g.text: Computers running agentrqd that can host agents for your workspaces.
A machine is a computer running agentrqd. Enrol one and you can run agents on it.
Run these on the machine itself. The code is single-use and expires shortly.
Starts it in the workspace's folder on this machine.
